# Custody boundary for this distribution

The unmodified task-226 wheel, lock, complete ujson and double-conversion
notices, unchanged evaluator sources and their Apache license are included.
The immutable ujson commit/tree and decoded default setup.py are carried as
source observations. INPUTS.sha256 binds these exact files to this build.

This distribution performs binary installation; it does not rebuild ujson.
The preserved PyPI HTTPS acquisition identifies the wheel publisher/origin and
bytes. Neither that acquisition nor matching source notices independently
attests the wheel producer's actual source tree, compiler, environment,
UJSON_BUILD_DC_LIBS setting, or original build invocation. No original wheel
build attestation is claimed. The new Docker build receipt attests only this
distribution's construction from the already built wheel and pinned base.

Runtime checks cover this CPython 3.12/Linux amd64/glibc image and these
fabricated inputs; they make no claim of minimum-manylinux or other-platform
compatibility, benchmark measurement, or production H0 authorization.
